fairness: Same candidate IDs, document splits, relation classes, and metrics for every method
TF-IDF vocabulary and both classifier heads fit on train only
Both learned models receive the same token-bounded mention-marked texts
Pretrained transformer is frozen; only its logistic head is fitted
No test-based hyperparameter selection; settings fixed in configuration
Rules operate on original sentence/mention spans; learned systems use bounded text
Training time is not directly comparable to fixed pretrained-model inference
limitations: Pseudo-labels are rule-derived, favouring related rules; not independent gold accuracy
Dev/test have zero causal support: held-out causal generalization is unmeasured
Small training set: only four causal training pairs
Relation classification alone does not estimate direction/polarity or justify a DAG edge
Historical LLM pilots cover different subsets and are excluded from this controlled comparison
Frozen encoder benchmark is not full transformer fine-tuning; pretraining corpus overlap is unknown

preprocessing.policy: Complete cases for model variables only; optional missing states retained
preprocessing.survey_design: Unweighted respondent-level model; not population prevalence or a design-based estimate
preprocessing.outcome: Self-reported diabetes OR prediabetes; pregnancy-only diabetes excluded

calibration_coverage.limitation: Only populated risk bins are assessed; calibration outside observed prediction support is unmeasured.

evaluation.causal_evaluation_requirements: A prespecified causal estimand, defensible identification assumptions, and independent interventional or credible quasi-experimental outcome evidence; an RCT linkage alone does not define a generic causal accuracy metric.
evaluation.interpretation: Unweighted held-out respondent prediction; not causal validation

observational.interpretation: Conditional probability; not an intervention or clinical recommendation

interventional.interpretation: Hypothetical intervention under the stated graph and assumptions; not clinical efficacy

identification.method: Truncated factorization in a fully observed causal DAG
limitations: No causal discovery or proof of absent unmeasured confounding
No front-door, latent-confounder ID algorithm, or transportability claim
BRFSS is cross-sectional self-report; timing and intervention consistency are assumptions
